newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Feb trade deficit seen at $1.5 bln-paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Feb trade deficit seen at $1.5 bln-paper.

text.p: The Brazilian government is likely to announce on Tuesday a trade deficit of about $1.5 billion for February, a local newspaper said.
Jornal do Brasil daily said the total deficit for the first two months of the year should amount to $2.0 billion.
Last year, Brazil posted a record $5.5 billion trade gap. The country is likely to post a trade deficit of over $8.0 billion for the whole of 1997, the newspaper added.
